Beyond the hobby PDF

Retail Blood Splatter

Steel City lists Blood Splatter in Hanger and Blaster packs, with reported runs of /200 or fewer. Named families include Kill Splatter, Ovalocity, posters, season inserts, quad relics, all four Laser Signagraph sizes, Laser Signapatches and the Invincible Comic #1 chase. Steel City links to the same hobby PDF from its Blaster page. Retail release details

San Diego Comic-Con 2025

Five announced daily Laser Signagraph drops, originally $40 each. Blue /75 was a We Are Heroes booth exclusive. The five announcements show which designs received Silver /500, Purple /250, Yellow /100, Blue /75, Blood Splatter /50, Orange /25, Gold /10, Red /5 and Black 1/1. Daily release schedule and print runs

Secondary-market leads include a convention Blood Splatter #236 /100 and a seller-described 449-card Blood Splatter set. I found listings for both. The full contents and print run of the 449-card set need independent confirmation. #236 listing · 449-card set listing

Holo Hobby and Holo Breaker

The Holo releases use chrome stock, with Holo-specific parallels and an Omni-Man Comic #1 Laser SignaPatch chase. The Premiere Hobby PDF ends with the Invincible Comic #1 chase. When comparing a card number across releases, verify the stock, finish and serial numbering. Keepsake Holo Breaker and checklist · Holo Hobby release
